items.hint: Also used to say 'sorry to trouble you'.
Very common in Singapore. In China: 没关系 (also used here).
啊 a adds warmth; a very common reply in Singapore.
Literally 'add fuel'; used to cheer someone on.

items.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ děng yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng lái.
items.english: Please wait a moment, I'll be right there.

items.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ yídìng bāng nǐ.
items.english: No problem, I will definitely help you.
Do you remember to bring your passport?

items.hanzi: 我已经吃了，你们慢慢吃。
items.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng chī le, nǐmen mànmàn chī.
items.english: I've already eaten. You take your time.

items.hanzi: 不好意思，麻烦你帮我一下。
items.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, máfan nǐ bāng wǒ yíxià.
items.english: Sorry, could you help me for a moment?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zǎo! Nǐ jīntiān zěnme lái wǎn le?
lines.english: Morning! Why are you late today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 地铁出问题了，我等了二十分钟。
lines.pinyin: Dìtiě chū wèntí le, wǒ děng le èrshí fēnzhōng.
lines.english: The MRT had a problem. I waited twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 真的吗？那你吃早餐了吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nà nǐ chī zǎocān le ma?
lines.english: Really? Have you had breakfast then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 还没有。我现在去买咖啡，你要吗？
lines.pinyin: Hái méiyǒu. Wǒ xiànzài qù mǎi kāfēi, nǐ yào ma?
lines.english: Not yet. I'm going to buy coffee now. Do you want one?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 好啊，我要一杯热的，谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ yào yì bēi rè de, xièxie.
lines.english: Yes, I'd like a hot one, thanks.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 没问题。十点的会，你记得吗？
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Shí diǎn de huì, nǐ jìde ma?
lines.english: No problem. The ten o'clock meeting, do you remember?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 当然记得啦，老板马上就来。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán jìde la, lǎobǎn mǎshàng jiù lái.
lines.english: Of course. The boss will be here soon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ kuài diǎn qù, yíhuì jiàn!
lines.english: Then I'll hurry. See you in a bit!

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 喂，小李，这个周末你有空吗？
lines.pinyin: Wèi, Xiǎo Lǐ, zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu kòng ma?
lines.english: Hello, Xiao Li, are you free this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 星期六有空，星期天我要去看医生。
lines.pinyin: Xīngqīliù yǒu kòng, xīngqītiān wǒ yào qù kàn yīshēng.
lines.english: Saturday I'm free. On Sunday I'm going to see a doctor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nǐ zěnme le?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 没什么啦，就是有点咳嗽。
lines.pinyin: Méi shénme la, jiùshì yǒudiǎn késou.
lines.english: Nothing much, just a bit of a cough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 那你要多休息哦。星期六晚上一起吃饭吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ yào duō xiūxi o. Xīngqīliù wǎnshang yìqǐ chīfàn ba?
lines.english: Then rest more. Shall we have dinner together on Saturday night?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Qù nǎlǐ chī? Nǐ xuǎn ba.
lines.english: Sure. Where shall we eat? You choose.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 你咳嗽，我们吃面吧，别吃太辣的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ késou, wǒmen chī miàn ba, bié chī tài là de.
lines.english: You have a cough, so let's have noodles, nothing too spicy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: OK, see you at the MRT station at seven.

questions.question: When and where will they meet?
questions.answer: At seven, at the MRT station
distractors: At six, at the MRT station
